changes: Added authority-boundary.ts classifier with L2+ requirements including independentVerifierRunId, commandDigest, transcriptHash, diffHash, envelopeSignature, and verifiedAuthorityReceipt; added classifyCliAuthoritySubmission wrapper in authority-submit.ts; added authority-boundary-smoke task and package scripts; updated authority-client-role.md trust-boundary docs and fixed routing table alignment after docs review.
usage: Run npm run test:authority-boundary-smoke to verify the visible CLI boundary. The command prints the pass line proving CLI evidence remains local/shadow/thin-client and is not receipt-backed L2+ authority. Existing npm run test:authority-client and npm run test:authority-evidence-flow continue to validate compatibility.
expectedOutcome: ✓ authority boundary smoke passed: CLI evidence is local/shadow/thin-client, not receipt-backed L2+ authority
actualTranscript: npm run test:authority-boundary-smoke printed: ✓ authority boundary smoke passed: CLI evidence is local/shadow/thin-client, not receipt-backed L2+ authority. koala validate --story=B-ec09 --json returned status=pass, allPass=true, verification coverage 12/12.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible difference: expected pass line appears exactly. Additional validation also passed.
limitations: Milestone 1 only. This does not implement Koala Runner CLI, Mac runner actor-key/signing, Python authority receipts, full EvidenceEnvelope FU-1/FU-2/FU-3, or receipt verification. Those remain separate routed stories/repo work.
pitfalls: Two review catches mattered: first, L2+ requirements initially missed commandDigest/transcriptHash/diffHash; second, docs initially mis-routed M2 as Runner work and mentioned M3-M7 while the table has M2-M6. Both were fixed before TEST, and evidence was refreshed after materialHash drift.
